description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for persistence operations within the project, including methods and embedded enums for default values and configuration paths.

classes.name: PersistenceOperationsConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration settings for persistence operations, including a method to retrieve delay duration and an embedded enum with known configuration values.

classes.name: PersistenceOperationsConfig.PersistenceOperationsConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration defining default config values and paths related to persistence operation delays.

methods.name: getDelayAfterPersistenceActorShutdown
methods.description: Returns the Duration to wait after a persistence actor shutdown before starting purging.
